name: capture_planning_source_baseline
description: Capture, reuse, or close the authoritative planning-source baseline for a planning-maturity feature. The Bash twin resolves repository identity, HEAD, workflow mode, audit profile, transition-contract digest, protected paths, and observed source identities internally; callers cannot supply or override them. Use action='capture' before planning writes. Use action='close' with outcome_option='--outcome' and outcome='completed' or 'aborted' when the planning run ends.

action.description: Baseline lifecycle action. Capture creates or reuses the active baseline; close closes the active baseline without recapturing.

outcome_option.description: Required transport token for action='close'; omit for action='capture'.

outcome.description: Closed planning-run outcome. Required for action='close'; omit for action='capture'.
